docs.title: TitanOres
docs.text: TitanOres is the endgame progression mod of the TitanMods modpack. It adds a chain of rare ores spread across the three dimensions, and a full line of tools, armor and special items that go well beyond netherite.

docs.title: Goals
docs.text:
• A real endgame. Every tier is clearly stronger than the last one, ending with Titanium Star gear.
  • Explore every dimension. Each ore lives in one specific biome: deep oceans, the Warped Forest and the End Highlands.
  • Mine it yourself. The ores cannot be mined by quarries/digital miners, are immune to explosions and only drop with the right pickaxe.
  • Modpack friendly. Forge tags for every material, optional Curios support and configurable data (recipes, loot, tags) through datapacks.

docs.title: Versions
docs.text: Property Value Minecraft 1.16.5 Forge 36.2.42 Mod version 1.0.5 Required Titan Utilities 1.0.0 (machines, final items and Blue Soil) Java (to play) 8 Optional Curios API 1.16.5-4.x (magnet charm slot)

docs.title: Installation (players)
docs.text:
1. Install Forge 1.16.5-36.2.42 (or newer 36.x).
  2. Drop titanores-1.0.5.jar and titanutilities-1.0.0.jar into the instance mods folder.
  3. Optional: add Curios API to wear the Solarite Magnet in a charm slot.

Look up recipes in game

Installing JEI (Just Enough Items) shows every TitanOres recipe, including smithing and armor upgrades.

docs.text: With a full set, the armor bar above the hotbar uses the material's own icon. If the set is incomplete, it shows the icon of the tier below (Titanium Star → Titanium → Emberite → Solarite → vanilla).

• The final items (Source Crystal, Sponge Bob, Ancestral Seed, World Core, Raid King, Antenna, Calculator, Iron Man Mask, Titanium Music Disc, Universal Remote) and Blue Soil moved to Titan Utilities (ids titanutilities:*). Essence crops now grow on the #titanores:essence_crop_soil block tag (Titan Utilities adds Blue Soil).

• The Hephaestus Forge Upgrades moved to Titan Utilities (titanutilities:forge_upgrade_tier_2..5).
  • Titan Crafter recipe (Titan Utilities): the iron blocks were replaced by Enderium Blocks.

• New companion mod Titan Utilities (required by the TitanMods modpack). The Titan Factory, Titan Crafter and Speed Upgrade moved there, with their recipes and JEI categories (ids titanutilities:*, machine block tag #titanutilities:machine_blocks).
  • Package renamed to com.titanmods.titanores.
• Hephaestus Forge Upgrades (Tier II, III, IV, X): right-click a Forbidden & Arcanus Hephaestus Forge to raise its tier.

• Ore processing: 2x in any crusher (Mekanism, IE, Create, Occultism, Blood Magic) and up to 5x with Mekanism (clumps, shards, crystals, dirty dust, slurries); dust smelts into ingots.
  • Farming: Blue Soil and Solarite, Emberite and Titanium crops (seeds, essences, 25% extra seed chance, 8 essences → 1 nugget; slower than wheat, no bone meal).

• Ores: Solarite (deep oceans), Emberite (Warped Forest) and Titanium (End Highlands), with manual-mining protection. The ore items show where to find them (dimension, biome and Y range).
  • Emberium alloy: made in the Titan Factory (3 Emberite + 3 Titanium Ingots → 3 Emberium, 40M FE; or 3 + 3 blocks → 3 Emberium Blocks, 80M FE).
  • Tools: Solarite, Emberite, Titanium (Area Mode, tree felling, fire aspect, auto-smelt) and Titanium Star.
  • Armor: Solarite, Emberite, Titanium and Titanium Star (90% damage reduction, flight, night vision), with per-piece abilities and a custom armor bar.
  • Special items: Titanium Heart, Solarite Apple, Solarite Carrot, Solarite Lantern, Solarite Magnet and Titanium Star.
  • Titan Factory machine: 100M FE buffer, gradual energy use, top input / bottom output automation, data-driven titanores:titan_factory recipes, upgrade slot for up to 4 Speed Upgrades (each doubles the speed). Crafting recipe for the machine (iron gears and machine blocks from any mod, via tags). Speed Upgrade recipe: 2 Clocks + 2 Potions of Swiftness + 2 Solarite Ingots, 800k FE.
  • Titan Crafter machine: 9×7 fixed-position shaped crafting (titanores:titan_crafting), 200M FE buffer, template-style top input, made in the Titan Factory.
  • Titanium Music Disc recipe in the Titan Crafter (36 Titanium Ingots + any music disc, 36M FE).
  • JEI: Titan Factory recipe category and Titan Crafter recipe categories (machine GUI, energy needed, animated progress, + button to fill the machine).
  • Final items: Source Crystal, Sponge Bob, Ancestral Seed, World Core, Raid King, Antenna, Calculator, Iron Man Mask, Titanium Music Disc and Universal Remote (the modpack's endgame components; recipes via KubeJS).
  • /titanores hearts command, Curios and Mantle integration.

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
All commands need permission level 2 (operator or cheats enabled).

Command Description /titanores hearts get [player] Shows how many Titanium Hearts a player has eaten /titanores hearts reset [players] Removes all Titanium Heart bonus health /titanores hearts set <0-255> [players] Sets the exact number of Titanium Hearts eaten (each one = +2 hearts)

docs.title: Keybinds & controls
docs.text: Input Action N (configurable in Options › Controls › Titan Ores) Toggles Night Vision while wearing the Titanium Star helmet Shift + right-click with a Titanium pickaxe, shovel or hoe Toggles Area Mode (3×3) Sneak while breaking a log with the Titanium axe Breaks a single log instead of the whole tree Right-click in the air with the Solarite Magnet Turns the magnet on or off

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
Root package: com.titanmods.titanores · mod id titanores.

Titan Utilities

The machines (Titan Factory, Titan Crafter, energy, containers, JEI), the Forge Upgrades, the final items and Blue Soil moved to the companion mod Titan Utilities (com.titanmods.titanutilities, mod id titanutilities). It depends on TitanOres; TitanOres does not depend on it. The sections below marked (Titan Utilities) describe code that lives there.

docs.title: Packages
docs.text: Package Contents init All registries (DeferredRegister): blocks, items, tile entities, containers, recipe serializers, loot modifiers, tags and the creative tab block Custom blocks and tile entities: manual-mining ore, lantern and invisible light, essence crops item Tool tiers (ModItemTier), armor materials (ModArmorMaterial), custom items and the Area Mode helper event Forge event handlers: armor abilities, automation blocker, mob spawns and dragon drop, health, tools, magnet world Ore generation (ModOreGeneration) loot Global loot modifiers (auto_smelt, replace_with_item) recipe titanores:upgrade_shaped (keeps the NBT of the upgraded armor piece); the machine recipe types are in Titan Utilities energy ModEnergyStorage, the Forge Energy buffer used by machines network SimpleChannel and the Night Vision toggle packet client Client-only code: screens, keybinds and HUD (armor bar, compact health bar) container Titan Factory and Titan Crafter containers compat Optional Curios integration (only loaded when Curios is present) and compat/jei (JEI plugin + Titan Factory category, loaded by JEI) command /titanores commands

docs.title: Key systems
docs.text:
• Worldgen: configured features are registered in FMLCommonSetupEvent and added per biome in BiomeLoadingEvent. Emberite and Titanium use NO_SURFACE_ORE, like ancient debris.
  • Manual mining: ManualMiningOreBlock returns no drops unless a real player breaks it, and AutomationBlocker cancels the BreakEvent of fake players for blocks in titanores:manual_mining_only.
  • Tiers: tool stats live in ModItemTier and armor stats in ModArmorMaterial. Unbreakable tiers use 0 durability and override isEnchantable.
  • Titanium tools: AreaToolHelper handles the Area Mode NBT flag, the toggle and the 3×3 breaking through ServerPlayerEntity.gameMode.destroyBlock (respects protections and normal drops), with a recursion guard.
  • Titan Factory (Titan Utilities): TitanFactoryTileEntity (tickable) holds a 7-slot ItemStackHandler and a ModEnergyStorage (100M FE, receive-only). Item capability per side: top = TitanFactoryItemHandlers.TopInput (column-aware insert), bottom = BottomOutput, sides = none; energy on every side. Recipes: recipe/TitanFactoryRecipe, type titanutilities:titan_factory. GUI data is synced through an IIntArray (energy split into two 16-bit halves).
  • Titan Crafter (Titan Utilities): TitanCrafterTileEntity (64 slots: 0-62 grid, 63 output; 200M FE). Same tick logic as the factory. Top input = TitanCrafterItemHandlers.TopInput (only tops up slots already holding the item). Recipes: recipe/TitanCrafterRecipe, type titanutilities:titan_crafting (fixed 9x7 pattern).

docs.title: Conventions
docs.text:
• Everything is in English: ids, file names and code comments. Portuguese only in lang/pt_br.json.
  • Textures live in lowercase per-material folders: textures/item/<material>/<material>_<item>.png and textures/block/<material>/. Worn armor goes in textures/models/armor/, interfaces in textures/gui/.
  • Every item is fire resistant (ModItems.props()).

docs.title: Common tasks
docs.text:
Command What it does gradlew build Builds the mod jar into build/libs/titanores-<version>.jar gradlew runClient Starts Minecraft with the mod (development environment) gradlew runServer Starts a dedicated server gradlew genIntellijRuns / genEclipseRuns Creates IDE run configurations gradlew processResources Copies the resources again (use with F3+T or /reload while the game is open)

Testing with other mods

Jars downloaded from CurseForge are obfuscated and crash the development environment if dropped into run/mods. Add them through build.gradle instead, for example runtimeOnly fg.deobf("group:artifact:version"). This is how Curios is added.

docs.title: Emberite
docs.text: A fiery ore found only near the ceiling of the Nether's Warped Forest.

docs.title: Where & How
docs.text:
Property Value Dimension The Nether Biome Warped Forest Height Y 95 – 125 Vein size up to 3 blocks Frequency 2 attempts per chunk (like ancient debris) Replaces netherrack, basalt, blackstone Exposure never touches air: you have to dig Pickaxe needed Solarite pickaxe (level 5) or better

Mine it yourself

  • No automation: quarries, digital miners and builders (any fake player) cannot break this ore, and if a machine breaks it anyway it drops nothing.
  • Explosion proof: TNT and creepers cannot destroy the ore or its storage block (blast resistance 1200).
  • Fire resistant: every TitanOres item survives lava and fire.

docs.title: Farming
docs.text: Solarite, Emberite and Titanium can be grown, Mystical Agriculture style: plant the seeds on Blue Soil, harvest essence and turn it into nuggets.

docs.title: Blue Soil
docs.text:
titanutilities:blue_soil

Part of Titan Utilities. The only block the essence crops grow on (not farmland or grass): the crops accept any block in the #titanores:essence_crop_soil block tag, which Titan Utilities fills with Blue Soil. Mine it with a shovel.

Made on the Mystical Agriculture Infusion Altar: Grass Block on the altar, 4 Insanium Blocks + 4 Eternal Dust on the pedestals (recipe added by the modpack with KubeJS).

What you need Amount Where Grass Block 1 on the altar Insanium Block 4 pedestals Eternal Dust 4 pedestals Infusion Crystal (or Master Infusion Crystal) — right-click the altar to start

docs.title: Seeds
docs.text:
Made on the Mystical Agriculture Infusion Altar (recipes added by the modpack with KubeJS): a Prosperity Seed Base on the altar, 4 Insanium Blocks and 4 blocks of the ore on the pedestals (alternating).

Seed On the altar Pedestals Solarite Seeds Prosperity Seed Base 4 Insanium Blocks + 4 Solarite Blocks Emberite Seeds Prosperity Seed Base 4 Insanium Blocks + 4 Emberite Blocks Titanium Seeds Prosperity Seed Base 4 Insanium Blocks + 4 Titanium Blocks SolariteEmberiteTitanium

docs.title: Crops
docs.text:
Seeds Crop Harvest (mature) Solarite Seeds titanores:solarite_crop 1 Solarite Essence + 1 seed back (+25% chance of an extra seed) Emberite Seeds titanores:emberite_crop 1 Emberite Essence + 1 seed back (+25% chance of an extra seed) Titanium Seeds titanores:titanium_crop 1 Titanium Essence + 1 seed back (+25% chance of an extra seed)
  • Crops have 8 growth stages and need light, like wheat, but grow slower (about 45 minutes on average).
  • Breaking an unripe crop only gives the seed back.
  • Bone meal does not work. Special growth items and accelerators from other mods (for example Mystical Agriculture's Fertilized Essence and Growth Accelerators) do.

docs.title: Botany Pots
docs.text:
The seeds also grow in a Botany Pot with Blue Soil as the soil (any other soil does not work): put the Blue Soil in the pot, then the seed.

Seed Growth time Each harvest Solarite / Emberite / Titanium Seeds 2 minutes (2400 ticks) 75% chance of 1 essence, 5% chance of an extra seed

The pot never needs replanting, so it gives a little less than harvesting the crop in the world.

docs.title: Essence to nuggets
docs.text:
8 essences in a ring on a crafting table make 1 nugget.

docs.title: Titanium Heart
docs.text:
titanores:titanium_heart

  • Source: dropped by the Ender Dragon every time it dies. In the End it appears on top of the exit portal pillar, so it never falls into the void.
  • Effect: eat it to gain +2 max hearts permanently. It can be eaten any time and as many times as you want (Minecraft caps max health at 1024).
  • The extra hearts are kept after death and after leaving the world.
  • Admins can manage them with /titanores hearts.

docs.title: Solarite Apple
docs.text:
titanores:solarite_apple

  • Source: Piglin bartering only. Each gold trade has a 1% chance to give a Solarite Apple instead of the normal loot. There is no crafting recipe.
  • Effects (3 minutes): Health Boost V (+10 hearts), Absorption V (+10 hearts), Fire Resistance, Resistance, Night Vision, Regeneration II.

docs.title: Solarite Carrot
docs.text:
titanores:solarite_carrot

  • Can only be eaten when hungry.
  • Effects: Saturation for 8 minutes (the hunger bar stays full) and Regeneration for 10 minutes.
Golden Carrot➜Crafting Table

docs.title: Solarite Lantern
docs.text:
titanores:solarite_lantern

  • Lights up the area: slowly places invisible light sources in dark spots within 16 blocks (max 128 lights). They are removed when the lantern is broken.
  • No hostile spawns: natural hostile mob spawning is blocked in the 3×3 chunks around it. Spawners and spawn eggs still work.
  • Needs an iron pickaxe or better. With Silk Touch it drops itself; otherwise it drops 8 Solarite Nuggets.
Sea Lantern➜Crafting Table

docs.title: Solarite Magnet
docs.text:
titanores:solarite_magnet

  • Right-click in the air to turn it on or off (Magnet: ON/OFF above the hotbar). It glows while on.
  • While on, it pulls dropped items and XP orbs within 11 blocks, from anywhere in your inventory.
  • Works in a Curios charm slot when Curios API is installed.
  • Respects the PreventRemoteMovement flag used by other mods (for example, items on conveyors).

docs.title: Forge tags
docs.text:
Every material registers the usual Forge tags, so ore processing mods and recipes in the pack recognise them.

Tag Values forge:ores/<material> Solarite, Emberite, Titanium ores (items and blocks) forge:ingots/<material> Solarite, Emberite, Titanium, Emberium forge:nuggets/<material> Solarite, Emberite, Titanium forge:dusts/<material> Solarite, Emberite, Titanium, Emberium forge:storage_blocks/<material> all material blocks forge:rods/solarite Solarite Stick

Dusts

The dusts have no recipe in the mod. They exist for ore processing recipes added by the pack (for example with KubeJS or CraftTweaker).

docs.title: Manual mining tag
docs.text:
titanores:manual_mining_only (block tag) contains the three ores. For blocks in this tag:

  • fake players (quarries, digital miners, builders) cannot break them, because the break event is cancelled;
  • the ores themselves drop nothing when broken by anything other than a real player.

The tag can be extended with a datapack to protect blocks from other mods.

docs.title: Data-driven content
docs.text:
Everything below can be changed with datapacks or KubeJS, without touching the code:

docs.title: Ore Processing
docs.text: Solarite, Emberite and Titanium ores can be multiplied like regular metals. Every route ends in dust, which smelts into an ingot (furnace or blast furnace).

docs.title: 2x: any crusher
docs.text:
One ore gives 2 dusts in:

  • Mekanism Enrichment Chamber
  • Immersive Engineering Crusher
  • Create Crushing Wheels and Millstone
  • Occultism crusher spirit
  • Blood Magic ARC (with cutting fluid)

These recipes only load when the mod is installed.

docs.title: Mekanism: up to 5x
docs.text:
Output Route 2x Enrichment Chamber: ore → 2 dust 3x Purification Chamber (oxygen): ore → 3 clumps → Crusher → dirty dust → Enrichment Chamber → dust 4x Chemical Injection Chamber (hydrogen chloride): ore → 4 shards → Purification Chamber → clump → … 5x Chemical Dissolution Chamber (sulfuric acid): ore → 1000 mB dirty slurry → Chemical Washer (water) → clean slurry → Chemical Crystallizer (200 mB) → crystal → Chemical Injection Chamber → shard → …

Mekanism stops at 5x (there is no 6x tier in Mekanism for 1.16).

docs.title: Intermediate items
docs.text:
Ore Dirty dust Clump Shard Crystal Slurries Solarite titanores:dirty_solarite, titanores:clean_solarite Emberite titanores:dirty_emberite, titanores:clean_emberite Titanium titanores:dirty_titanium, titanores:clean_titanium

Item tags follow Mekanism's names (mekanism:clumps/<ore>, mekanism:shards/<ore>, mekanism:crystals/<ore>, mekanism:dirty_dusts/<ore>), so other mods and KubeJS scripts can use them.

docs.title: Progression
docs.text:
TitanOres follows one line: each material is needed to reach the next one.

flowchart LR
    N[Netherite pickaxe] --> S[Solarite<br/>Overworld · Deep Oceans]
    S --> SP[Solarite pickaxe]
    SP --> E[Emberite<br/>Nether · Warped Forest]
    E --> EP[Emberite pickaxe]
    EP --> T[Titanium<br/>End · End Highlands]
    T --> TS[Titanium Star<br/>+ Nether Star]

docs.title: Step by step
docs.text:
1. Get a netherite pickaxe (vanilla) and explore deep ocean biomes. Dig below Y 16 to find Solarite.
  2. Craft Solarite tools. The Solarite pickaxe (harvest level 5) is the only way to mine Emberite, found high in the Nether's Warped Forest.
  3. Upgrade your Solarite tools to Emberite in a smithing table. The Emberite pickaxe (harvest level 6) mines Titanium inside the islands of the End Highlands.
  4. Upgrade to Titanium gear: unbreakable tools with special abilities.
  5. Kill withers, craft a Titanium Star and upgrade to Titanium Star gear, the final tier.

docs.title: Harvest levels
docs.text:
Level Pickaxe Mines 4 Netherite (vanilla) Solarite ore and block 5 Solarite Emberite ore and block 6 Emberite Titanium ore and block, Emberium block 7 Titanium / Titanium Star everything

Pickaxes from other mods with an equal or higher harvest level also work.

Wrong pickaxe = no drop

With a lower level pickaxe the ore still breaks (slowly) but drops nothing.

docs.title: Solarite
docs.text: The first TitanOres material. A golden ore hidden deep below the ocean floor.

docs.title: Where & How
docs.text:
Property Value Dimension Overworld Biomes Deep Ocean, Deep Cold Ocean, Deep Lukewarm Ocean, Deep Frozen Ocean Height Y 0 – 16 Vein size up to 4 blocks (usually 1–3) Frequency 1 attempt every 2 chunks (rarer than diamond) Replaces stone, granite, diorite, andesite Pickaxe needed Netherite (level 4) or better

Tip

The deep ocean floor sits around Y 30–45, so Solarite is always buried well below it.

Mine it yourself

  • No automation: quarries, digital miners and builders (any fake player) cannot break this ore, and if a machine breaks it anyway it drops nothing.
  • Explosion proof: TNT and creepers cannot destroy the ore or its storage block (blast resistance 1200).
  • Fire resistant: every TitanOres item survives lava and fire.

docs.title: Titan Crafter
docs.text:
titanutilities:titan_crafter

Part of Titan Utilities, the TitanMods companion mod (requires TitanOres).

An energy-powered 9×7 crafting grid for the final crafts. Recipes are shaped with fixed positions: every item has to be in its exact slot.

Work in progress

The final recipes are not defined yet.

docs.title: Crafting
docs.text:
Made in the Titan Factory:

Crafting TableCrafting TableEnderium BlockanyEnderium BlockanyIron GearanyIron Gearany➜Titan Factory · 80,000,000 FE · 240s · columns can be swapped

The iron gears are temporary: the plan is to use diamond gears once the modpack has them.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
• Place the items in the grid exactly as the recipe shows (JEI page or + button).
  • When the grid matches a recipe and the output has room, the machine spends energy gradually (recipe energy ÷ recipe time, every tick) and pauses without power, keeping its progress.
  • Each used slot consumes 1 item per craft.
  • The bar under the output shows the progress; hover the bar on the right to see the stored energy.

docs.title: Energy
docs.text: Property Value Energy type Forge Energy (FE / RF) Buffer 200,000,000 FE Input limit none (limited only by the cable) Accepts energy from every side

docs.title: Automation
docs.text:
Side Items Top Input, template style (see below) Bottom Output. Pull the result from below. Sides no item access

Template filling

Put one set of the recipe in the grid by hand. After that, items inserted from the top (hoppers, pipes, AE2 / Refined Storage) only top up slots that already hold the same item, always the one with the fewest items. Items that are not in the grid are refused, so the pattern is never broken.

docs.title: Recipe format (modpacks)
docs.text:
{
  "type": "titanutilities:titan_crafting",
  "pattern": [
    "         ",
    "         ",
    "   AAA   ",
    "   ABA   ",
    "   AAA   ",
    "         ",
    "         "
  ],
  "key": {
    "A": {"item": "examplemod:item_a"},
    "B": {"tag": "forge:example_tag"}
  },
  "energy": 100000000,
  "time": 2400,
  "result": {"item": "examplemod:result_item", "count": 1}
}

The ids above are placeholders that only show the format.

Field Meaning pattern Exactly 7 rows of 9 characters. Each character is one grid slot; a space means the slot must be empty. No offset or mirroring. key Symbol → ingredient. Items, tags ({"tag": ...}) and forge:nbt ingredients work. energy Total FE for one craft. time Ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). FE per tick = energy / time. result Output item and count.

docs.title: Titan Factory
docs.text:
titanutilities:titan_factory

Part of Titan Utilities, the TitanMods companion mod (requires TitanOres).

An energy-powered machine that combines two columns of items into one result.

Work in progress

The name may change and more recipes are coming.

docs.title: Crafting
docs.text:
GlassanyIron GearanyMachine BlockanyIron GearanyIron Gearany➜Crafting Table Symbol Ingredient Emberite Ingot / Solarite Ingot from this mod Glass any colorless glass (#forge:glass/colorless) Iron Gear any mod's iron gear (#forge:gears/iron): Thermal Foundation, Immersive Engineering, ... Machine Block any block in #titanutilities:machine_blocks

The titanutilities:machine_blocks tag ships with optional entries (ignored when the mod is missing): Mekanism Steel Casing, Thermal Machine Frame, Industrial Foregoing Machine Frame, Immersive Engineering Light Engineering Block and RFTools Machine Frame. Modpacks can add more with a datapack (data/titanutilities/tags/items/machine_blocks.json with "replace": false) or KubeJS.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
• Put the ingredients in the two columns (3 slots on the left, 3 on the right, top to bottom).
  • When the items match a recipe and the output has room, the machine starts working and spends energy gradually (total recipe energy ÷ recipe time, every tick).
  • If the energy runs out, it pauses and resumes when power comes back (progress is kept).
  • Removing the ingredients resets the progress.
  • The bar under the output shows the progress; hover the red bar on the right to see the stored energy.

docs.title: Energy
docs.text: Property Value Energy type Forge Energy (FE / RF): works with Mekanism, Powah, Thermal, etc. Buffer 100,000,000 FE Input limit none (limited only by the cable) Accepts energy from every side

docs.title: Speed upgrades
docs.text:
Speed Upgrade (titanutilities:speed_upgrade) goes into the upgrade slot in the tab on the right side of the GUI, next to the energy bar (up to 4 stacked). Hover the tab icon to see how many are installed.

Upgrades Speed Emberium recipe time FE/t 0 x1 60 s ~33,333 1 x2 30 s ~66,667 2 x4 15 s ~133,334 3 x8 7.5 s ~266,667 4 x16 3.75 s ~533,334

Each upgrade halves the recipe time. The total energy per craft stays the same, so the machine pulls more FE per tick: faster crafting needs better cables and generators. It is made in the machine itself (see Recipes below).

docs.title: Automation
docs.text:
Side Items Top Input. Hoppers, pipes, AE2 / Refined Storage interfaces insert here. Bottom Output. Pull the result from below. Sides no item access

Upgrade slots are not accessible by automation.

Smart column filling

Recipes are column based, so items inserted from the top go to the column that already holds the same item (or the first empty column) and are spread over its 3 slots. Inserting 3 Emberite Ingots and then 3 Titanium Ingots from a hopper builds the Emberium recipe automatically.

docs.title: Recipes
docs.text:
➜3Titan Factory · 40,000,000 FE · 60s · columns can be swapped ➜3Titan Factory · 80,000,000 FE · 120s · columns can be swapped ClockClockSpeed PotionSpeed Potion➜Titan Factory · 800,000 FE · 10s · columns can be swapped Crafting TableCrafting TableEnderium BlockanyEnderium BlockanyIron GearanyIron Gearany➜Titan Factory · 80,000,000 FE · 240s · columns can be swapped

The Speed Upgrade needs the plain Potion of Swiftness (3:00): the long, strong and splash versions are not accepted. Its columns mix different items, so it has to be filled by hand (top automation cannot build it).

JEI

With JEI installed, press U on the Titan Factory (or R on a result) to see its recipes drawn on the machine GUI, with the energy each one needs and an animated progress bar. In the machine GUI, click the arrows to open them, and use JEI's + button to move the ingredients from your inventory into the right columns.

docs.title: Recipe format (modpacks)
docs.text:
Recipes are data-driven (data/<namespace>/recipes/*.json) and can be added or changed with a datapack:

{
  "type": "titanutilities:titan_factory",
  "left":  [ {"item": "titanores:emberite_ingot"}, {"item": "titanores:emberite_ingot"}, {"item": "titanores:emberite_ingot"} ],
  "right": [ {"item": "titanores:titanium_ingot"}, {"item": "titanores:titanium_ingot"}, {"item": "titanores:titanium_ingot"} ],
  "mirrored": true,
  "energy": 40000000,
  "time": 1200,
  "result": { "item": "titanores:emberium_ingot", "count": 3 }
}
Field Meaning left, right Up to 3 ingredients each, top to bottom. null = that slot must be empty. Each position consumes 1 item. Tags work ({"tag": "forge:ingots/iron"}). mirrored Also accept the two columns swapped. energy Total FE for one craft. time Ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). FE per tick = energy / time. result Output item and count.

docs.title: Tools
docs.text: Four tiers. Each one is obtained from the previous tier, and enchantments are kept on every upgrade.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Tier Harvest level Durability Mining speed Enchantability How to get Solarite 5 12,000 10 85 Crafting table (ingots + Solarite Stick) Emberite 6 24,000 15 85 Smithing: Solarite tool + Emberite Ingot Titanium 7 Unbreakable 18 85 Smithing: Emberite tool + Titanium Ingot Titanium Star 7 Unbreakable 26 85 Smithing: Titanium tool + Titanium Star

For comparison: netherite has level 4, 2,031 durability and mining speed 9.

docs.title: Titanium abilities
docs.text:
Titanium and Titanium Star tools share the same abilities.

Tool Ability Sword Built-in Fire Aspect: sets targets on fire for 8 s. Mobs killed in one hit drop cooked food. Pickaxe Area Mode: mines 3×3 and auto-smelts ores (iron, gold, modded ores…). Silk Touch disables the smelting. Shovel Area Mode: digs 3×3 and auto-smelts ores. Hoe Area Mode: tills 3×3. Axe Tree felling: breaking any log fells the whole tree (up to 256 logs).

Area Mode

  • Shift + right-click toggles Area Mode (message Area Mode: ON/OFF above the hotbar). It starts ON.
  • Sneaking while mining breaks a single block.
  • The 3×3 never breaks bedrock or blocks much harder than the one you mine (no obsidian when digging stone).

Tree felling safety

The axe only fells natural trees (logs touching natural leaves or nether wart blocks), so log houses are safe. Sneak to break a single log.

Unbreakable tools

Titanium tools never lose durability, so Unbreaking and Mending are not offered for them. Every other enchantment works, including the enchanting table.
